rationale: Despite the massive 22.80% gap up and an exceptionally strong broader market (SPY +4.89%), APLD is exhibiting severe relative weakness, trading near the bottom of its daily range (5.3%) well below both session VWAP ($14.40) and its 5-minute 9-EMA ($13.95).
